acceptanceCriteria: Flow A produces job J, flow B consumes J: a change in A's anchored code lists B affected with path A->J->B.
An unreviewed relation is reported, never silently traversed.
Spec/requirement updated in the same change.
body: Add typed flow-relation records to the corpus input profile with optional source anchor and review state; impact/affected --corpus traverse them downstream to a configurable depth with path attribution, failing closed on unreviewed relations; corpus MCP trace tool walks the same relations. Source: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/1225
title: GH #1225: docs corpus typed flow relations (depends-on, produces/consumes, external) traversed by impact/affected
